title: NGS Prep from .csv
author: Opentrons
materials: 1.5ml snapcap tube for pooling * tube A
1.5ml screwcap tube for final pooled libraries
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Collect all consumables and equipment listed for the NGS library prep.

substeps.instruction: Bio‑Rad Hardshell 96‑well PCR plate, 200 µL (catalog #HSP9601)
Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 3×5 insert (holds 15 mL NEST centrifuge tubes)
Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tuberack with 4×6 insert (holds 15 mL NEST centrifuge tubes)
Opentrons P20 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette
Opentrons P300 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette
Opentrons 20 µL tiprack
Opentrons 300 µL tiprack
TE buffer (enough to fill tube A1 to ~3 cm below opening)
1.5 mL snap‑cap tube for pooling (tube A1 in 4×6 rack)
1.5 mL screw‑cap tube for final pooled libraries (tube A2 in 4×6 rack)
CSV file containing all volumes for the protocol

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as described in the deck map.

substeps.instruction: Insert the 3×5 tuberack into slot 4; fill tube A1 with TE buffer to ~3 cm below the opening.
Insert the 4×6 tuberack into slot 5; place a 1.5 mL snap‑cap tube in A1 for pooling and a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube in A2 for final pooled libraries.
Load the Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plate into the appropriate slot.
Load the 20 µL tiprack and the 300 µL tiprack into their designated slots.
Mount the P20 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel pipettes on the robot.

steps.title: Set pipette mount sides and CSV
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, specify the mount side for each pipette and provide the volume CSV file.

substeps.instruction: Enter the mount side (left or right) for the P20 pipette.
Enter the mount side (left or right) for the P300 pipette.
Upload or point to the .csv file that contains all volume specifications.

steps.title: Download and upload protocol
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol file and load it into the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the source repository or location.
Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration procedures for all labware, tipracks, and pipettes via the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Select each piece of labware on the deck and perform tip‑length calibration.
Calibrate the 20 µL tiprack for the P20 pipette.
Calibrate the 300 µL tiprack for the P300 pipette.
Follow the Opentrons support articles for detailed calibration steps if needed.

steps.title: Execute the NGS prep
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the protocol, which will perform 2‑fold dilutions and final pooling as defined in the CSV.
